action_summary: Restore tie-producing postprocessing after the existing v46 mean ensemble, using five equal-width bins independently per target, ordinal min-max normalization to [0,1], and continuous fallback for degenerate columns. This follows the strongest historical evidence: discretized versions reached about 0.425-0.427 while raw-output versions were about 0.381-0.388. The old exact bin settings are unavailable, so five uniform bins are an explicit unvalidated candidate rather than a claim to reproduce v45; the historical comparisons also changed checkpoints. Keep the existing Kaggle paths, checkpoint, NER/math preprocessing, and evaluator unchanged to isolate the output-mapping change. Save raw predictions as a diagnostic CSV and add shape, finite-value, ID, range checks with sample-submission row alignment. No training or inference was run; only static syntax and JSON checks were performed.
